def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    mask = bins >= item
    priorities = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf)
    remaining = bins[mask] - item
    priorities[mask] = item / remaining if np.any(remaining > 0) else np.where(remaining == 0, np.inf, -np.inf)
    return priorities

    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
